leadStory: FSG have reached agreement to sell a strategic minority stake of about a third in Liverpool to a consortium led by Amit Bhatia and including Jeff Bezos and Eduardo Saverin, valuing the club near £4.4bn ($6bn) in a deal framed as a path to control, with an announcement expected within days. On the grass Ronald Araujo was officially unveiled on loan in the No. 33, the Barcola chase turned difficult near €150m (Rayan and Minteh added to the winger board), Mbaye is the Paris name Liverpool now lead for, and Curtis Jones nears an Inter exit.
subject: Anfield exterior and the FSG boardroom era turning over, an ownership headline the size of the summer, no single hero moment
